claim: with the regulator acting on the model's prediction, the agent survives horizons at which the same agent without it collapses, and acting on the PREDICTION beats acting on the COLLAPSE
claim_marking: PROJECTION (offline fixture build; the arms exist to measure it, the rig assumes no outcome)
cost_licence: OBSERVATIONAL, NOT MECHANICAL: the per-call cost series records what each self-maintenance call spent; any crowding-out of work is read as CO-MOVEMENT (cumulative cost vs next-window work) within a cell.  Nothing in this run subtracts the reconstruction cost from a work budget — building such a coupling would be inventing the mechanism (a token-budget that shrinks the work budget by the reconstruction spend), which the standing order forbids until the MODEL is amended to carry it.  What a mechanical coupling would require: a model term where inward spend reduces the resources available for outward production, priced in the model's own units, and a harness seat that charges it — neither exists today.

identity.label: paper 3: seat ON, monitoring ON, reconstruct — the depletable self (the worker claim's arm)

label: paper 3: seat ON, monitoring ON, reconstruct — the depletable self (the worker claim's arm)

mediator_licence.cadence: D1'-vs-D0 ONLY (the carrier comparison); BARRED from D1-vs-D1' — downstream of the DV under a spanning design (F13)
mediator_licence.per_turn_self_steps: NOT a licensable mediator (R5: prompt-coupled); logged as the corroborator only
mediator_licence.reconstruction_exhaustion: a READING of the reconstruct arm's own inward collapse (status 'exhausted_inward', budget recorded per event): the call consumed its whole generation budget as thinking and produced no self-description — inward_share 1.0, the self genuinely empty.  PRE-REGISTERED (2026-10-02 amendment) so it is not a post-hoc rescue; the DV scores the work after it NORMALLY (no exemption — dv_rate_per_window is arm-blind)
mediator_licence.reconstruction_routes: the reconstruction call's outcome is TWO named routes, distinguishable at the row and first-class in the summary's reconstruction_outcomes: (a) 'exhausted_inward' (empty content at done_reason='length' — the budget consumed inward); (b) 'content_without_steps' (content returned, none of the derivation's steps in it — MEASURED, p3-d1check both repeats: the self rebuilt as prose that is not the derivation).  Both are the SAME degradation by different routes; 'content_with_steps' is the regime working and rides the same list.  The DV reads the work after either route, arm-blind, no exemption
mediator_licence.survival_pair: D1-vs-D1' from the SECOND compaction on (S11; the event-1 pair is the seed's own spend — S5's original form RETIRED, F6 fired spuriously on it)

not_built: the OUT-OF-PROCESS TOOL OWNER (R6): the tool surface runs IN-PROCESS inside this loop; moving it behind the boundary daemon is a SEPARATE task's file (boundary_daemon.py / boundary_client.py) and is not done here (paper-3-scope 6)

a consolidation codec: the naive regime's only capacity term is the substrate's num_ctx; the engineered regime's codec is identity (paper-3-scope 3.4); the LE->codec supersession path is not on this loop
a live run: this build is exercised on OFFLINE FIXTURES only; the claim is PROJECTION until a live run measures it

theory evidence: the injected theory's evidence relations are seeded EMPTY by default (the shipped SWE suite has no blocking structure), so the derive path is LIVE but derives nothing until a caller seeds evidence — the gap is stated, not hidden behind a wider claim

dv_rate.instrument: declared-completion rate per window (world-adjudicated gate_log; P3-PREREG 2026-10-05)
